Timezone offset calculation incorrect for positive offsets

#### Description

When parsing timezone information from timestamps, positive timezone offsets (like `+01:00`) are being calculated incorrectly. The timezone offset appears to be inverted for positive values.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import gpxpy
import datetime

# Test with a positive timezone offset
xml = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx>
<trk>
<trkseg>
<trkpt lat="35.794159" lon="-5.832745"><time>2014-02-02T10:23:18+01:00</time></trkpt>
</trkseg></trk></gpx>'''

gpx = gpxpy.parse(xml)
point_time = gpx.tracks[0].segments[0].points[0].time

# Check the timezone offset
print(f"Parsed time: {point_time}")
print(f"UTC offset: {point_time.utcoffset()}")

# Expected: UTC offset should be +1 hour (60 minutes)
# Actual: UTC offset is incorrect
```

The issue also affects time formatting when converting back to XML - timestamps with positive timezone offsets don't round-trip correctly.
